name: leather bracers
_design_note: F1-25 light arms slot. Oil-hardened leather forearm guards. Bracers_of_Cu_Chulainn uses this as template_basis.
lore_template: Forearm bracers of oil-hardened {material_name}, strapped from wrist to elbow over the tendons that a glancing blade would otherwise find first. Archers prize bracers of this make additionally for the bowstring snap they prevent — a small consideration that has saved many an arm over years of practice.
